_readme: Named value bands. Each key is a phrase sellers say; each value is a WHERE-clause fragment against columns of the items view. The engine looks up your threshold and adds it to the SQL template  -  no LLM call, no free-form SQL.

_docs.example-use: 'big orders' → price >= 500. Question 'how many big orders in 2017?' becomes 'orders WHERE price >= 500 AND purchase_date BETWEEN 2017-01-01 AND 2017-12-31'.
_docs.careful: A wrong threshold gives a wrong count. Say the threshold on the answer if audience-facing (the template does: 'big orders (>= R$ 500.00)').
